resources.string: Voice model not downloaded — open Comrade and tap a voice button to set it up
Microphone permission is required for voice.

Comrade\'s voice features run fully offline — speech never leaves this phone. That needs a one-time download of the English recognition model (%1$s). On a metered connection you may want to wait for Wi-Fi.
Tap to pick up where you left off
Another model is downloading — try again once it finishes.
This model isn\'t available to download yet.
Microphone (and camera for video) permission is required to call.
Open chat and shrink the call

Keep receiving messages and calls while Comrade is unlocked but not on screen. Shows a low-priority notification while active. With this off, messages and calls arrive only while Comrade is open — nothing is lost, but you won\'t be notified until you come back.

Off by default: screenshots and screen recording work everywhere in Comrade. Turn this on and the system refuses both, and the app is hidden from the recents preview. It cannot stop a photo of your screen, and it applies to your device only — never to the person you are talking to.

When there\'s no direct route to someone, a file can only reach them through a relay server — someone else\'s bandwidth, and their machine in the middle. Your calls keep their relay either way; this is only about files.
Never \u2014 only send files over a direct connection
Drops the decrypted key from memory immediately. You’ll need your passphrase to unlock again.

Direct calls work for most pairs of devices. Some networks (notably carrier-grade NAT) need a relay server to connect at all — configure one here if calls fail to connect. Calls always try a direct connection first; the relay is only used if that fails.
No relay configured — calls that can’t connect directly will fail instead of falling back
Relay reachable — calls can fall back to it if a direct path fails
Relay unreachable — check the server URL and credentials
Bluetooth audio needs the Bluetooth permission — falling back to speaker
Choose the people whose company you want to know about. Your comrades — and nobody else, not even a relay — are told when you\'re online. You see them the same way: once they\'ve chosen you back.
No comrades yet. Pick a contact below, or open any conversation\'s ⋮ menu and choose “Make a comrade”.
Save a contact first — start a chat, and they\'ll show up here.
waiting for them to choose you back
No threads yet. Reply to a message and it becomes one.
The first message isn\'t on this device
No topics yet. Name one, then file a thread under it.

Messages in this chat are sealed with your key and theirs (NIP-44) and gift-wrapped, so relays carry neither the text nor who is talking to whom. Nobody without one of the two private keys can read it — not a relay, not us.
Names are claims; this key is the identity. Compare it with them over a channel you already trust to be certain who you\'re talking to.
Their future messages will be dropped before they reach you, and this chat leaves your list. They are not told. You can start a new chat with their key later.
Messages, message requests, calls, comrades coming online and app updates each have their own channel, so you can silence one without silencing the rest.
Notifications are turned off for Comrade — nothing will reach you while the app is in the background, including calls.
Muting is stored on this device only — Comrade has no server to sync it through, and a muted chat still shows its unread count and still rings for calls.

Asks github.com once a day whether a newer Comrade has been published, and notifies you if there is — including while Comrade is closed. That tells GitHub your IP address and nothing else — no account, no identifier, no message data. With this off, nothing is checked until you tap “Check now”.
Skipped %1$s — you\'ll be told about anything newer.

Comrade is installed by sideload, so the update is fetched here rather than from a store. On Android 12 and newer it usually installs without a confirmation dialog — Comrade closes, the new version goes in, and a notification offers to reopen it. Some devices still ask you to confirm; either way Android refuses an APK signed with a different key than the copy you already have.
Waiting for Android to install it…
Android asks once, per app, before an app may install another. Without it the update can still be downloaded here and installed from the release page in your browser.
This release has no single APK to download — open the release page instead
The downloaded update is no longer there — download it again
Comrade needs your permission to install apps — grant it in Settings, then tap Install again
Android could not install the update
There is not enough free space to install the update — free some up and try again
That download is not Comrade — refusing to install it
That download is not newer than the version you are running
That download is signed by a different key than your copy of Comrade — refusing to install it
That download is not a readable APK
The download did not match the size the release published
You\'ve been reading a while. Nothing wrong with that — but if you came here to feel better rather than to catch up, there might be a kinder way to spend the next ten minutes.

Silences Comrade\'s notifications overnight — messages, requests, comrades coming online, update notices. A ringing call always comes through: someone calling at 3am may be exactly who this app is for. Nothing is lost, only delayed until morning.
Set on this device only — Comrade has no server to sync it through.

Android can tell Comrade how long your screen was on, how often you picked the phone up, and how long you spent in apps you choose to mark. Comrade keeps three numbers a day — that\'s all — sealed in the same encrypted store as your journal. It never leaves this phone; there is no server to send it to. You can turn the permission off again whenever you like.
No usual yet — a few more days and this can compare you only to yourself.
Your call entirely — Comrade ships no list of “bad apps”, because which ones are a problem is yours to say and nobody else\'s. Marked apps get their own line in the mirror.
These are your own numbers next to your own recent days. Not a score, not a target, and not compared to anyone else.
What will you give this time to?
Uses Android\'s Do Not Disturb, which needs a one-time permission. Calls still ring.
This is practice, not a test: attention gets easier to hold by holding it. Stopping early is information, not failure — nothing here keeps a streak to break.
No sessions yet. Twenty-five minutes on one thing is a good place to begin.
An article, a chapter, a letter — share one into Comrade from any app, or paste it here. It stays on this phone, encrypted like your journal. Comrade never fetches it from the web for you.
That\'s the end. Worth a line about it?
Nothing saved yet. Share an article into Comrade — or paste one below — and it will wait here.
Shared in — give it a look before you keep it.
Gentle, seated-friendly stretches for your neck, shoulders and back — under three minutes, with nothing to get right. Nothing about the break is recorded.
That was the whole routine. However much of it you did was enough.
Only you will see this — it goes to Tara, not to them.
Tara will answer here — you\'ll both see it.
Two contacts answer to @%1$s — which one?
A copy goes into your chat with them, encrypted like any other message. The entry stays in your journal, and nothing else from it is sent.
You haven\'t saved anyone yet. Add a contact from Chats first — a note is only ever sent to someone you chose.
Dictate — turns what you say into text
Record a voice entry — keeps your voice
That was too short to keep. Hold on a moment longer.
Could not record. Another app may be using the microphone.
Microphone permission is needed to record a voice entry.
The entry and its recording will both be removed from this phone. There is no other copy.

Kept in Comrade\'s own folder on this phone — your gallery never sees it, and no other app can open it. What you write stays sealed by your passcode; the recording itself is protected by the phone, not the passcode.
This recording is no longer on this phone
The recording is gone from this phone. The entry is still here — you can delete it if it is no use without the video.
Camera permission is needed to record a video entry.
No camera app on this phone to record with.
That is the time you asked for. Stay as long as you like.
Four counts in, four held, four out, two to settle — follow the buzz if you\'d rather close your eyes. No account of this is kept here, and your comrades are told only that you might need them.

string-array.name: breathe_lines_in
string-array.item: Breathe in. Your body knows how to do this.
Take in as much as is comfortable — no more.
You reached for this. That already counts.
Feel the floor still holding you up.
Just this breath. Not the rest of it.
You are here, and you are breathing.
Slowly. There is no hurry in this.
One breath, and then one more.

string-array.name: breathe_lines_out
string-array.item: And out. You don\'t have to feel better yet.
Let it go, and let your shoulders down with it.
Nothing more is being asked of you right now.
Let your jaw and your hands go loose.
Whatever it is can wait until after.
Let it leave without pushing it.
Soften your face as it goes.
You don\'t have to do this well.

resources.string: These tools are for practising attention, not for fixing it, and Comrade will not pretend otherwise. There is decent evidence that using your phone more deliberately, reading longer things, and sleeping better all help you concentrate — and no good evidence that any app “restores” anyone\'s brain. So you\'ll find no scores here, no levels, and nothing telling you that you failed. Everything stays on this phone.
Pick something, pick someone. You’ll both hear it at the same moment.
Nothing is uploaded. You each play your own copy, and only the play, pause and position travel between you.
Anything on the device — music or video
A YouTube video, or a podcast episode
No music on this phone yet.
To list your music, Comrade needs permission to read it. It looks at nothing else, and the file never leaves this phone.
Comrade isn’t allowed to read your music. You can turn that on in Android’s app settings — or open a file by hand instead.
Showing the first 2,000 tracks. Search to find the rest.
Your library was read up to 2,000 tracks, so this album may be missing some. Search from the library screen to find them.
The next thing you pick will ask who to listen with.
A YouTube link plays for both of you. So does a direct link to an audio or video file — a podcast episode, an Internet Archive track — which you each fetch yourselves.
Looks the song up online — the only source that leaves your phone
Type a song and we\'ll ask a public music catalogue what it is, then look for your own copy of it. Only what you type is sent.
The catalogue has nothing by that name. Try the artist as well as the title.
This build can\'t search online. Your own music and links still work.
Stream from your own Subsonic or Navidrome — alone or together
Searches the music library on your own server. What plays here streams straight from it — and if you listen together, the link to each track is shared with the person you\'re listening with.
Add your server in Settings → Music sources — its address, your username and password. It streams your own library, so this app never sees a copy of anything on it.
This build can\'t reach a music server. Your own music and links still work.
Where the Together tab streams music from. Your credentials stay on this phone; a stream URL shared during a session carries only a per-request token, never your password.
A Jamendo key adds openly-licensed tracks you can download to the by-name search. Leave blank to search MusicBrainz alone.
Free music from the Internet Archive, and any podcast feed
No synced lyrics found for this track.
Nothing loved yet. Tap the heart on a row in your library.
Play something and it will show up here.
No copy of \u201C%1$s\u201D on this phone. Try another result, pick a file, or ask the other person to send theirs.
Saving to your music library needs Android 10 or newer.
Your music library refused a new entry.
This catalogue only knows the name, not the audio
Its licence doesn\'t allow a copy
That isn’t something Comrade can play. A YouTube link works, or an https link that points straight at an audio or video file.
That didn’t play. If it was a link, it may not point straight at an audio or video file.
They’ll be asked, and nothing starts on their phone until they say yes.
Nobody to ask yet — start a conversation first.
Play it here, on your own
Couldn\'t reach them just now — they haven\'t heard this yet.
That couldn\'t be started. Try something else, or a different link.
%1$s put this on. Playing something else stops it for both of you.
Your phone fetches the same link theirs is playing. Nothing is copied between you.
No copy of that on this phone — pick the file.
waiting for them to open it
Positions travel over the network, so you\u2019ll be within about a second of each other \u2014 not frame-perfect.
This keeps playing when you leave the app.
YouTube pauses when you leave the app \u2014 keep it open to keep watching.
Whoever posted this doesn\'t allow it to play outside YouTube.
That video isn\'t there any more — it may be private or deleted.
Opening YouTube leaves the session — nothing changes on their phone, and the embed here pauses.
To follow along in the app you already use, Comrade needs notification access \u2014 that\u2019s how Android lets it read and control what\u2019s playing. It reads no notifications and keeps nothing.
Nothing is playing on this phone yet \u2014 start it in your own app, then tap again.
They\u2019ll see and hear what you\u2019re playing, live. Nothing is saved on their phone, and it stops when you do.
Android will ask to record this screen \u2014 that\u2019s how Comrade sends the sound of what you\u2019re playing. Decline and they\u2019ll still see the picture, without its audio.
Your microphone goes out with the sound of what you\u2019re playing. Use headphones, or they\u2019ll hear it twice.
Your microphone can\u2019t join while you\u2019re watching their stream. It\u2019ll work on the next thing you play.
Comrade is following another app on this phone. It can play, pause and place the playhead \u2014 it can\u2019t show you the picture.
For the two of you on one bike. Say the few things the engine drowns out.
No location is shared \u2014 only the words you tap. Anything you send stops being shown after a minute, because by then it isn\u2019t true any more.
Big buttons, spoken alerts, no keyboard.
You get the map, the music and the words.
Nothing playing. Start something on the Together tab and it\u2019ll show up here.
Keep your eyes up. Anything urgent is spoken and buzzed \u2014 you don\u2019t need to look at this.
Comrade needs your approximate location to find what\u2019s worth eating and seeing around you.
Location is off, so there is nothing to look around. You can turn it on in Android settings.
Couldn\u2019t get a location fix. Step outside or turn location on, then try again.
Nothing to show for this spot yet. Try a wider radius.
Your exact position never leaves this phone \u2014 lookups are rounded to a ~150 m block first.
Review counts in the thousands come from Google Maps, which needs a key of your own. Comrade ships none, and stores yours in the encrypted vault.
A key is saved on this device.
No key saved \u2014 places and facts still work; ratings do not.
